lines.en: label tsuneyoslumber3:
scene ferriswheel1

We manage to make it onto the ferris wheel just before the ride is closed up, upsetting a park worker in the process as she was very clearly ready to go home for the day and now has to wait another ten minutes.
lines.zh: 我们赶在设施关停前上了摩天轮，过程中惹恼了一位园区工作人员——她显然已经迫不及待要下班回家，现在却还要再等十分钟。

lines.en: I’m not too concerned, though. We’ve already upset several other staff members throughout the day due to Tsuneyo’s incessant insistence that her “husband” is coming to pay for her. One more won’t hurt.
lines.zh: 不过我不太在意。今天一整天，因为 Tsuneyo 坚持不懈地宣称她的“丈夫”会来替她付钱，我们已经惹恼了好几个工作人员。再多一个也无妨。

lines.en: As the wheel begins to turn and the glowing theme park lights transition from blindingly bright and distorted spheres to tiny balls of multicolored neon, I think again about how surreal this all feels.
lines.zh: 随着摩天轮开始转动，游乐园璀璨的灯光从刺眼扭曲的光球，变成一颗颗五颜六色的霓虹小球，我再次觉得这一切有多么超现实。

lines.en: Just a short while ago, Tsuneyo was doing everything in her power to avoid me — harboring well-deserved, rational resentment for things that I did or didn’t do and now she’s...
lines.zh: 就在不久前，Tsuneyo 还在竭尽全力躲着我——对我做过或没做过的那些事怀着理所应当、合乎情理的怨恨，而现在她……

lines.en: Now she’s my wife.
lines.zh: 现在她是我妻子了。

lines.en: Not literally, of course. They don’t offer wedding services here as far as I know, nor would I be able to afford them if they did as Tsuneyo has drained every last bill from my wallet today.
lines.zh: 当然不是字面意义上的。据我所知这里不提供婚礼服务，就算提供我也负担不起，因为 Tsuneyo 已经把我钱包里最后一纸币都榨干了。

lines.en: But even knowing that every single utterance of the word “husband” was only detached from her tongue for the sole purpose of replacing those words with overpriced food...it felt nice.
lines.zh: 但即便知道她每吐出一次“丈夫”这个词，唯一的目的就是用那些词换回昂贵的食物……那感觉还是很好。

lines.en: Different.
lines.zh: 很不一样。

lines.en: And all it took to get something like this out of her was a single facial expression and a small dose of venom I must have accidentally spit out after growing tired of her point of view.
lines.zh: 而要让说出这种话，所需要的不过是我脸上的一个表情，以及一小剂毒液——想必是我厌倦了她的观点之后，不小心吐出来的。

lines.en: It’s important to reiterate, however, that I did not grow tired of it because it had gotten stale...or because the monster in question had already been shoved back underneath my bed-
lines.zh: 不过要重申一点：我厌倦它，不是因为它已经变得陈腐……也不是因为那个怪物已经被塞回了我的床底——

lines.en: But because I hate being reminded that its decayed and outstretched arms have the chance of poking back out and strangling me whenever they want.
lines.zh: 而是因为我讨厌被提醒：它那双腐烂而伸长的手臂，随时有可能再次探出来掐死我。

lines.en: One day, I will surely breathe my last.
lines.zh: 总有一天，我必然会咽下最后一口气。

lines.en: But for the time being, I will continue to pretend the monster is gone-
lines.zh: 但眼下，我会继续假装那个怪物已经不在了——

lines.en: And envenomate anyone who reminds me that I’m only saying that.
lines.zh: 并且向任何提醒我“那只是我在自我安慰”的人注入毒液。

lines.en: : You doing okay, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ve ever been this high up before. Are we sure that this is safe?
lines.zh: : 我想我从来没有到过这么高的地方。我们确定这东西安全吗？

lines.en: : If it’s not, at least we’ll die together.
lines.zh: : 万一不安全，至少我们会一起死。

lines.en: : I don’t like the sound of that. I’m not ready to become a tree.
lines.zh: : 这话听着我不喜欢。我还没准备好变成一棵树。

lines.en: : If you’re that scared, you can close your eyes and wait out the rest of the ride. I’ll tell you when it’s over.
lines.zh: : 你要是这么害怕，就闭上眼睛，等这段旅程结束。结束了我会告诉你。

lines.en: : Do not mock me or I will attack you. These hands have dealt the touch of death on many occasions and one more will not cause me any pain at all.
lines.zh: : 别嘲笑我，不然我会攻击你。这双手曾多次降下死亡的触碰，再多一次也不会让我有丝毫痛苦。

lines.en: : Alright. But when the ride speeds up and our cart detaches, don’t tell me I didn’t warn you.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过等设施加速、我们的车厢脱离的时候，别说我没警告过你。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel2
: When {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么{/i}时候？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s an old theme park tradition. The last ride of every night is supposed to be for thrill-seekers.
lines.zh: : 是啊。这是游乐园的老传统。每晚的最后一趟是留给追求刺激的人的。

lines.en: : All of the cars on the ferris wheel come detached and are put back on in the morning. They’re extremely durable, though. So even if ours comes undone at the very top, we’ll survive.
lines.zh: : 摩天轮上所有的车厢都会脱开，第二天早上再装回去。不过它们极其坚固。所以就算我们的车厢在最顶端脱落，我们也活得下来。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel3
: Probably?!
lines.zh: : 大概吧？！

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ve never been here before so I can’t really vouch for this park’s safety. But again, at least we’d die together.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我从没来过这里，所以没法替这个园区的安全性打包票。不过再说一次，至少我们会一起死。

lines.en: : How do you remain so calm in the face of imminent danger? Why did you not stop me from going through with this? You are supposed to be a coward as well. You have betrayed me.
lines.zh: : 面对迫在眉睫的危险，你怎么能这么冷静？你为什么不阻止我把这事做完？你也应该是个胆小鬼才对。你背叛了我。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo-
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo——

lines.en: scene ferriswheel4
: I have not yet said my goodbyes. I must call the Emerald Guardian and-
lines.zh: : 我还没道别呢。我必须打电话给翡翠守护者，还有——

lines.en: : Actually, that’s it. I am not particularly close with anyone else.
lines.zh: : 其实，就这些了。我跟别人也没什么特别亲近的。

lines.en: : Calm down.
lines.zh: : 冷静点。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel5
: Do not lure me into {i}un{/i}certain death and then ask me to be calm. You don’t have the right.
lines.zh: : 别把我骗进一场生死{i}未{/i}卜的死亡里，然后又叫我冷静。你没有这个权利。

lines.en: : I do, because I was kidding. It’s a normal ferris wheel where all of the cars stay attached and there is minimal risk of death.
lines.zh: : 我有，因为我是在开玩笑。这就是个普通的摩天轮，所有车厢都不会脱开，死亡风险极低。

lines.en: : You are only saying that because you don’t want to be stuck in a small box with someone while they are on the phone.
lines.zh: : 你这么说，只是因为不想和一个正在打电话的人一起被关在小盒子里。

lines.en: : No, I’m saying it because I was an asshole and forgot that you have a hard time discerning sarcasm.
lines.zh: : 不是，我这么说是因为我是个混蛋，忘了你很难分辨讽刺。

lines.en: : And also, I just wanted to fuck with you because it’s funny.
lines.zh: : 还有，我就是想逗你玩，因为这很好笑。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel6
: I am filing for divorce the moment I step outside of this box. I will not allow myself to be abused like this any longer.
lines.zh: : 我一走出这个盒子就去申请离婚。我不会再允许自己被这样虐待了。

lines.en: : We had a good run.
lines.zh: : 我们有过一段好时光。

lines.en: : What a shame it must end with deceit and treachery. I always knew you were not to be trusted.
lines.zh: : 可惜它必须以欺骗和背信弃义收场。我一直都知道你不可信。

lines.en: : Did you have a good time despite that?
lines.zh: : 尽管如此，你今天玩得开心吗？

lines.en: scene ferriswheel7
: Yes, actually.  It was the most fun I’ve had in a long while. And all I needed to do to feel this way was shirk my one and only responsibility of maintaining Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 说实话，开心。这是我很长一段时间以来最开心的一天。而要让我有这种感觉，我只需要推卸掉我唯一的一份责任——维持 Tojo Ramen。

lines.en: : The store will still be there tomorrow. I’m sure you don’t have to worry.
lines.zh: : 店明天还在那儿。我敢肯定你不用担心。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel8
: It would be nice if I could believe you.
lines.zh: : 要是我能相信你就好了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess I kind of ruined any chance of being believable for the rest of the night after the whole “imminent danger” thing.
lines.zh: : 是啊，闹了“迫在眉睫的危险”那一出之后，我今晚剩下的时间里大概都没什么可信度了。

lines.en: : That’s not what I mean.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : I likely would not have returned home regardless of whether or not you showed up today. But your appearance {i}did{/i} help me take my mind off of things...so, thank you for that.
lines.zh: : 不管你今天来不来，我大概都不会回家。但你的出现{i}确实{/i}帮我分散了注意力……所以，谢谢你。

lines.en: : Take your mind off of what, though? Why are you so scared of going home all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 分散什么注意力？你怎么突然这么害怕回家？

lines.en: : I’m afraid I can’t say. But that’s in no part to me not {i}wanting{/i} to. It’s just a feeling I have.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我不能说。但这并不是因为我不{i}想{/i}说。只是一种感觉。

lines.en: : I told you earlier that the weather felt different...and it feels that way now as well. Like the calm before an unfathomable storm or...being caught in the eye of a hurricane.
lines.zh: : 我早些时候说过，感觉今天的天气不一样……现在也还是这种感觉。就像一场莫测的风暴来临前的平静，或者……像是被困在飓风眼里。

lines.en: : Every moment is preceded by an overflowing feeling that disaster is mere moments away, and it is like a voice inside of my head is telling me it will arrive the moment I return home.
lines.zh: : 每一刻之前，都涌动着一种灾难近在咫尺的感觉，就像我脑子里有个声音在告诉我：我一回家，它就会降临。

lines.en: : Huh...
: And now {i}you{/i} sound worried as well.
lines.zh: : 现在连{i}你{/i}听起来也很担心了。

lines.en: : It’s kind of hard not to be. The last time a student told me something about having a horrible premonition like that, Yumi beat the shit out of Nodoka and Makoto’s father died.
lines.zh: : 这很难不担心。上次有学生跟我说类似的可怕预感时，Yumi 把 Nodoka 打得半死，Makoto 的父亲也死了。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel9
: Her...
lines.zh: : 她的……

lines.en: : {i}Father...{/i}
: That...no, hold on. I wasn’t insinuating that something horrible is going to happen to your father. I was just saying I can’t really {i}disregard{/i} when people say things like that anymore.
lines.zh: : 那……不，等等。我不是在暗示你父亲会出什么可怕的事。我只是说，我已经没法再对这种话{i}置若罔闻{/i}了。

lines.en: : Maybe months ago, I would have thought you were crazy or something. But now, I’m...a little more cautious.
lines.zh: : 也许几个月前，我会觉得你疯了之类的。但现在，我……谨慎多了。

lines.en: : Skeptical, sure. But I don’t think you’re weird for believing something bad may happen when-
lines.zh: : 当然我还是持怀疑态度。但我不觉得你相信会有坏事发生有什么奇怪，当——

lines.en: : When what?...
lines.zh: : 当什么？……

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. There’s no point.
lines.zh: : 别管了。没有意义。

lines.en: : Finish your thought...
lines.zh: : 把话说完……

lines.en: : When I feel the same exact way.
lines.zh: : 当我也有完全一样的感觉时。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel10
: I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: : It’s somehow a relief knowing that I’m not as alone as I thought I was in feeling this way.
lines.zh: : 知道我并不是像自己以为的那样独自怀有这种感觉，不知为何让我松了口气。

lines.en: : I just wish you would have told me sooner so I did not have to go through the entire day feeling so out of place.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望你能早点告诉我，这样我就不用一整天都觉得自己格格不入。

lines.en: : I tried...kind of.
lines.zh: : 我试过……算是吧。

lines.en: : It’s related to something I’ve been trying to talk to you about all day, but you just...kept changing the subject. I was never able to say {i}anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这跟我一整天都在试图跟你谈的事有关，可你只是……不停地换话题。我始终{i}一个字{/i}都没能说出口。

lines.en: : It’s no fault of your own, though. It’s only natural that you’d do the same thing everyone else does since...that’s what the world {i}wants{/i} you to do or whatever. I have no idea how it works.
lines.zh: : 不过这不是你的错。你做出和所有人一样的反应再自然不过，因为……这个世界大概就是{i}想让{/i}你这么做吧。我完全不知道它是怎么运作的。

lines.en: : Try again now.
lines.zh: : 现在再试一次。

lines.en: : There’s no point. The same thing will happen again, over and over and over because that’s the way things are here. But one day, I have a feeling you’ll-
lines.zh: : 没有意义。同样的事会一遍、一遍、又一遍地重演，因为这里的事情就是这样。但总有一天，我有种感觉你会——

lines.en: scene ferriswheel11
: You’re misunderstanding something.
lines.zh: : 你误会了一件事。

lines.en: : I kept changing the subject not because of some predetermined outline or divine intervention, but because I did not want the illusion of this day away from everything to be prematurely dispelled.
lines.zh: : 我之所以不停地换话题，不是因为什么预设好的大纲或神明的干预，而是因为我不想让这逃离一切的一天所营造的幻象过早破灭。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : It is abundantly clear that there is something you wish to discuss with me, I just don’t want to hear it until we leave this place.
lines.zh: : 很显然你有事想跟我谈，我只是不想在离开这里之前听到它。

lines.en: : If I wanted to be reminded of the world outside of this charade of a relationship, I would not have spent the entire day running.
lines.zh: : 如果我想要被提醒这场关系之外的世界，我就不会花整整一天的时间奔跑了。

lines.en: : So...wait. Do you remember anything you said on the beach about how everything feels like it’s moving in circles sometimes?
lines.zh: : 那么……等等。你还记得你在海滩上说的那些话吗？关于有时候一切感觉都在绕圈子。

lines.en: : I do. Just as I remember how you said it actually {i}is.{/i} And then my subsequent comparison of you to my father.
lines.zh: : 记得。正如我记得你说它{i}确实如此{/i}。还有我随后把你比作我父亲。

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} what you’ve been trying to talk to me about?
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}就是你一直想跟我谈的事？

lines.en: : Yes. That’s {i}exactly{/i} what I’ve been trying to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : 是的。那{i}正是{/i}我一直想跟你谈的事。

lines.en: : If it was that important, why did you let me walk away the first time you brought it up?
lines.zh: : 既然那么重要，为什么我第一次提起时你放我走了？

lines.en: : It...took me by surprise, I guess. No one ever really acknowledges it.
lines.zh: : 我……大概是措手不及吧。从来没有人真的承认过这件事。

lines.en: : Also, something was brought to my attention very recently that made this all seem significantly more urgent.
lines.zh: : 而且最近有件事引起了我的注意，让这一切显得紧迫了许多。

lines.en: : And even though I’m not sure if telling you about it will change anything, myself and several others think it might be worth a try getting you a little more “involved.”
lines.zh: : 虽然我不确定告诉你会不会改变什么，但我和其他几个人觉得，让你多“参与”一点也许是值得的。

lines.en: : Involved in what? I don’t understand what you’re trying to tell me.
lines.zh: : 参与什么？我不明白你想说什么。

lines.en: : The world is part of a never-ending cycle and, in order to try and find out {i}more{/i} about that cycle, I need you to sleep at my house so we can do experiments and ultimately save the world one day.
lines.zh: : 世界是一个无止境循环的一部分，而为了弄清{i}更多{/i}关于这个循环的事，我需要你去我家过夜，这样我们才能做实验，并最终在某一天拯救世界。

lines.en: : Or at least figure out more about it.
lines.zh: : 或者至少多弄清楚一点。

lines.en: : Also, you might see some of your classmates disintegrate or wind up being forced to walk through an empty version of Kumon-mi all by yourself for an undisclosed amount of time.
lines.zh: : 另外，你可能会看到一些同学灰飞烟灭，或者被迫独自在一座空荡荡的 Kumon-mi 里走一段说不准有多久的时间。

lines.en: : Are you in?
lines.zh: : 你加入吗？

lines.en: scene ferriswheel12
: Hm.
: That’s it? That’s all you have to say in response to my major revelation about how the world is not what it’s disguising itself as?
lines.zh: : 就这样？对于我这个关于世界并非它伪装出来的样子的重大发现，你就只有这句回应？

lines.en: : Do you mind if I ask a few questions?
lines.zh: : 你介意我问几个问题吗？

lines.en: : Doing that at my house with everyone else would probably be better and more informative, but I’ll try my best to fill in some blanks now.
lines.zh: : 在我家、当着其他人的面问大概更好也更有信息量，不过我现在尽力填补一些空白吧。

lines.en: : How does this relate to what I said about everything feeling different today?
lines.zh: : 这跟我说的今天一切都感觉不一样有什么关系？

lines.en: : A cycle is about to end, apparently. {i}I{/i} can’t feel it, but Maya can. Maybe you’re feeling the same thing?
lines.zh: : 一个循环似乎快要结束了。{i}我{/i}感受不到，但 Maya 能。也许你感受到了同样的东西？

lines.en: : Maya is involved too?
lines.zh: : Maya 也参与其中？

lines.en: : And Ayane. And Yumi, but she’s in the same boat as you right now in not being a full-fledged member of the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad.
lines.zh: : 还有 Ayane。还有 Yumi，不过她现在跟你处境相同，都还不是天台末日小队的正式成员。

lines.en: : That’s a good name.
lines.zh: : 这名字不错。

lines.en: : Ayane made it. It’s subject to change when Maya ultimately vetoes it.
lines.zh: : 是 Ayane 起的。等 Maya 最终否决之后还会改。

lines.en: : What happens when this cycle ends?
lines.zh: : 这个循环结束时会发生什么？

lines.en: : We start a new one. The school year partially resets along with a portion of everyone’s memories.
lines.zh: : 我们开启新的循环。学年会部分重置，每个人记忆的一部分也会重置。

lines.en: : How is it determined which memories stay and which ones go?
lines.zh: : 怎么决定哪些记忆留下、哪些消失？

lines.en: : No clue.
lines.zh: : 毫无头绪。

lines.en: : How many times has this happened?
lines.zh: : 这种事发生过多少次了？

lines.en: : Again, no clue.
lines.zh: : 还是毫无头绪。

lines.en: : How many times have we met?
lines.zh: : 我们见过多少次面？

lines.en: : Us? Just one.
lines.zh: : 我们？就一次。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel13
: That’s it? I was under the assumption it would be a lot more.
lines.zh: : 就这样？我还以为会多得多。

lines.en: : It probably is. According to Maya, I’ve had my consciousness reset a bunch of times. But for some reason, this version of me is lasting way longer than the others, so now a bunch of weird shit is happening.
lines.zh: : 大概是多得多。据 Maya 说，我的意识被重置过很多次。但不知为何，这个版本的我比其他那些持续得久得多，所以现在一堆奇怪的事情正在发生。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, I’m glad that you’re cooperating right now, but you’re way calmer about this than you should be.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，我很高兴你愿意配合，但你对此冷静得实在不正常。

lines.en: : I’m confused about that myself. I understand how irrational this all is, but I can’t help but feel like it’s not my first time hearing it.
lines.zh: : 我自己也很困惑。我明白这一切有多不合常理，可我忍不住觉得这不是我第一次听到这些。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I mean none of it comes as a surprise to me...but I don’t have any recollection of this either. Everything just automatically makes sense and I can not put my finger on {i}why.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，这些话没有一句让我感到意外……可我对此也没有任何记忆。一切都自然而然地讲得通，而我却说不出{i}为什么{/i}。

lines.en: : Then come to the sleepover. Maya is going to want to hear that and she’d probably have trouble accepting it if it came from me instead of you.
lines.zh: : 那就来参加睡衣派对吧。Maya 会想听这些，而且如果这话是从你嘴里说出来而不是从我嘴里，她大概更容易接受。

lines.en: : I will. You have my word.
lines.zh: : 我会的。我向你保证。

lines.en: : But can I ask one more thing? It will be the last question as it appears our ride is about to come to an end.
lines.zh: : 但我能再问一件事吗？这是最后一个问题了，看来我们的旅程快要结束了。

lines.en: : Then I’ll answer as quickly as I can.
lines.zh: : 那我尽快回答。

lines.en: : If for some reason, my consciousness resets...
lines.zh: : 如果出于某种原因，我的意识被重置了……

lines.en: : And my memories of this day are not included in the portion I get to keep with me...
lines.zh: : 而我能保留的记忆里，不包括关于这一天的部分……

lines.en: : Will you take me here again?
lines.zh: : 你会再带我来这里吗？

lines.en: : That’s it? {i}That’s{/i} your final question? Why?
lines.zh: : 就这样？{i}这就是{/i}你最后的问题？为什么问这个？

lines.en: : Because I get it now.
lines.zh: : 因为我现在懂了。

lines.en: : Get {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 懂{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : What the rest of them see in you.
lines.zh: : 懂她们其他人在你身上看到的东西。

lines.en: : For the first time today, I saw it as well.
lines.zh: : 今天我第一次也看到了。

lines.en: : I feel like I shouldn’t forget that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得自己不该把这件事忘掉。

lines.en: : You’d be better off if you did.
lines.zh: : 你忘掉会更好。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel14
: I do not want to debate you on whether or not this memory will be beneficial to us.
lines.zh: : 我不想跟你争论这段记忆对我们有没有益处。

lines.en: : I just want to know if you’ll let me feel this way again.
lines.zh: : 我只想知道，你会不会让我再次有这种感觉。

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : I’ll take you here as many times as you want.
lines.zh: : 你想来多少次，我就带你来多少次。

lines.en: : Just, again...please don’t tell Io.
lines.zh: : 只是，再说一次……别告诉 Io。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel15
: I won’t tell a soul.
lines.zh: : 我一个字都不会说。

lines.en: : This day exists to no one but us.
lines.zh: : 这一天只存在于我们之间。

lines.en: scene black
: And it really is a shame that it must come to an end.
lines.zh: : 而它终将结束，真是可惜。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel16
: I’ll see myself home. I'm ready now...
lines.zh: : 我自己回家就行。我现在准备好了……

lines.en: : But you don’t have to accompany me.
lines.zh: : 但你不必陪我。

lines.en: : Are you sure? We’re miles away from the Old District and I don’t mind taking you back.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？这里离旧城区有好几英里，我不介意送你回去。

lines.en: : There’s no need. It appears the park provides a shuttle to an area near my neighborhood. I wouldn’t ask you to go that far out of your way when I’m capable of doing it on my own.
lines.zh: : 没必要。园区似乎有班车开往我家附近。既然我自己能行，我就不必让你绕那么远的路了。

lines.en: : Then I guess...this is where we part ways.
lines.zh: : 那我想……我们就在这里分别吧。

lines.en: : I will drop the divorce papers off with our family attorney in the morning. Thank you for doing this amicably.
lines.zh: : 我明早会把离婚协议书送到我们的家庭律师那里。谢谢你和平分手。

lines.en: : And thank you for the best day of married life I’ve ever had. I’ll send you a text with the address and time that you need to come over soon.
lines.zh: : 也谢谢你给了我婚姻生活中最美好的一天。我很快会发短信告诉你过来的地址和时间。

lines.en: : I don’t need the address. I’ve been to your home before.
lines.zh: : 我不需要地址。我去过你家。

lines.en: : Yeah...about that. I have a second one now. It’s a long story. Please don’t tell anyone.
lines.zh: : 嗯……说起这个。我现在有第二个家了。说来话长。请别告诉任何人。

lines.en: scene ferriswheel17
: Just how many secret lives are you living?
lines.zh: : 你到底过着多少重秘密生活？

lines.en: : Way too many...I don’t know how I do it, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 太多了……说实话，我都不知道自己是怎么做到的。

lines.en: : Regardless, you’ll be needing my phone number if you intend to contact me.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，你既然打算联系我，就需要我的电话号码。

lines.en: : No need. I got it from Molly earlier.
lines.zh: : 不需要。我早些时候从 Molly 那儿拿到了。

lines.en: : That seems like an invasion of privacy, but it saves me the effort of repeating it to you, so I will let it slide.
lines.zh: : 这听起来像侵犯隐私，不过省得我再跟你重复一遍，我就睁一只眼闭一只眼吧。

lines.en: : Hey, be mad at her. Not me. I’m not the one dealing out your personal info.
lines.zh: : 嘿，要生气冲她去。别冲我。又不是我把你的个人信息散出去的。

lines.en: : Good. Because if anyone finds out I am divorced, it will make finding another husband all the more difficult.
lines.zh: : 很好。因为如果有人发现我离婚了，我再找个丈夫就会难上加难。

lines.en: : I hope you never find one.
lines.zh: : 我希望你永远找不到。

lines.en: : I hope you mean that.
lines.zh: : 我希望你是认真的。

lines.en: scene black
: Goodnight.
lines.zh: : 晚安。

lines.en: Tsuneyo gets onto a bus and I hang around the entrance of the theme park until it takes off toward the Old District.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 上了一辆巴士，我在主题公园入口徘徊，直到它朝旧城区驶去。

lines.en: I decide to walk home instead of catching a ride myself. I’m not quite sure why, but...if I had to take a guess-
lines.zh: 我决定走路回家，而不是自己也搭一程。我不太确定为什么，不过……如果非要我猜——

lines.en: It would be that I wanted the day to carry on for a little while longer.
lines.zh: 那大概是因为我想让这一天再延续得久一点。

lines.zh: 新的一天开始了，我知道自己必须做什么……
